column3: MT 108:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; אַף־ כְּבוֹדִי (“also my glory”) is rendered “even with my glory.”
Close to the Hebrew; הַנֵּבֶל (“lyre”) is rendered “lute.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” and “faithfulness” are rendered “mercy” and “truth.”
Close to the Hebrew; בְּקָדְשׁוֹ (“in his holiness”) is rendered “in His holiness,” and “I will triumph” “I will rejoice.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the protection of my head” is rendered “the helmet for My head,” and “commander’s staff” “My lawgiver.”
Close to the Hebrew; מִצָּר (“from the foe”) is rendered “from trouble.”
